programme.title: Lonely Hearts
programme.desc: Lonely Hearts, kiehtova tarina pakosalla olevista sarjamurhaajista, perustuu Martha Beckin ja Raymond Fernandezin 1940-luvun loppupuolella tekemiin murhiin sekä etsivä Elmer C. Robinsonin osuuteen tekijöiden pidättämisessä, vangitsemisessa ja lopulta teloittamisessa.

programme.title: Management
programme.desc: Lasillinen samppanjaa ja taputus pepulle voi viedä pitkälle! Turhautunut uranainen myyntimatkalla ja sekopäinen motellinjohtaja, joka pitää halvasta samppanjasta ja pyöreästä takapuolesta? Ei kuulosta hyvältä yhdistelmältä, mutta mitä vaan voi tapahtua autiossa tienvarsihotellissa...

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel kertoo Taistosta (Turo Pajala, Hamlet liikemaailmassa), pohjoissuomalaisesta kaivosmiehestä. Kun kaivos suljetaan, Taisto kääntää Cadillacin keulan kohti etelää. Helsingissä Taisto asuu Pelastusarmeijan yömajassa, etsii työtä ja rakastuu uutteraan yksinhuoltajaäitiin.

programme.title: I, Daniel Blake
programme.desc: 59-vuotias Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) on työskennellyt suurimman osan elämästään puuseppänä Newcastlessa. Sydänkohtauksen ja työtapaturman suistettua hänen elämänsä raiteiltaan hän saa huomata, ettei yhteiskunnan turvaverkko kannattelekaan kaikkia.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming To Christmas Dinner?
programme.desc: Aktiivinen, liberaali ja edistyksellinen oikeustieteen opiskelija Maya tuo uuden poikaystävänsä kotiin jouluksi - kertomatta perheelleen, että hän on valkoinen. Arvaa, kuka tulee joulupäivälliselle?

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: Rikkinäisessä perheessä kasvanut 17-vuotias Violet (Fanning) unelmoi pop-tähteydestä ja paosta pienestä englantilaisesta kotikylästään.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Siltojen alla asusteleva alkoholisti Matti (Matti Pellonpää) on saamassa Amerikan tädiltään huomattavan perinnön, mutta miehen tulisi olla edustuskelpoinen tädin vierailun ajan. Matti kertoo tilanteesta autokauppiaana työskentelevälle ystävälleen, joka ehdottaa korvausta vastaan roolien vaihtoa.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnon voittaja ja myös kansainvälisesti palkittu elokuva, voitti myös 2011 Cannesin elokuvajuhlilla, elokuvakriitikkojen järjestön Fiprescin palkinnon, parhaan koiranäyttelijän sekä ekumeenisen tuomariston palkinnot.

programme.title: Kauas pilvet karkaavat
programme.desc: Kauas pilvet karkaavat kertoo helsinkiläispariskunnasta. Raitiovaununkuljettaja ja perinteikkään ravintola Dubrovnikin hovimestari menettävät työnsä, mutta eivät toivoaan Aki Kaurismäen (Le Havre) Suomi-trilogian ensimmäisessä osassa.

programme.title: Paluu Yorkshireen
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison (Jim Broadbent) saa tietää, että hänellä on syöpä ja vain muutama viikko aikaa elää. Hänen vanhin poikansa Blake (Oscar-voittaja* Colin Firth) muuttaa Yorkshireen äitinsä luokse, kylään jossa hän syntyi. Kun Arthurin tila heikkenee, Blake puntaroi suhdettaan isäänsä.

programme.title: Majava
programme.desc: Majavasta voi olla apua sinullekin! Walter Blackin huumori on yhtä mustaa kuin hänen sukunimensä. Töissä menee huonosti, vaimo on saanut tarpeekseen ja poika vihaa isäänsä.

programme.title: Mark Of A Murderer
programme.desc: Mark of a Murderer on tositarina NYPD-etsivä Vincent Lamarasta, joka on brutaalin murhaajan kintereillä. Epäillyn tavoittaessaan etsiväkonkari rukoilee kerrankin erehtyneensä: poliisin haaviin on jäänyt Joey Lamara, Vincentin oma poika!

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Ray Keene (John Cusack), isä, joka haluaa lunastaa paikkansa poikansa (Jamie Anderson) silmissä, yrittää saada maailmanluokan salamurhaajan Cardenin (Morgan Freeman) oikeuden eteen.

programme.title: Kidnapping Mr. Heineken
programme.desc: Sisäpiirin tarina olutmoguli Alfred Freddy Heinekenin sieppaajien suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta, rajuista jälkimainingeista ja lopullisesta tuhosta vuonna 1983, mikä johti suurimpiin koskaan maksettuihin lunnaisiin yksilöstä.

programme.title: The Cabin
programme.desc: Nuoripari matkustaa syrjäiselle mökille selvittelemään suhdettaan. Sitten mökille ilmestyy yllätysvieras; tuntematon mies pahat mielessä. Matkasta tulee oikea painajainen, ja nuoret joutuvat kamppailemaan hengestään.

programme.title: Then Came You
programme.desc: THEN CAME YOU kertoo kuolemansairaasta teinistä Skyesta (Maisie Williams) ja luulosairaasta 19-vuotiaasta Calvinista (Asa Butterfield), joka pelkää omaa varjoaankin.

programme.title: Happy-Go-Lucky
programme.desc: Opettaja Poppy selviytyy optimisminsa turvin elämän pienistä vastoinkäymisistä ja levittää ympärilleen iloa ja naurua.

programme.title: I Love You Phillip Morris
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva komedia mallikansalaisesta Steven Russellista, jonka radikaalilla elämänmuutoksella on hintansa. Patologisen valehtelijan munaukset vievät miehen suoraan kaapista häkkiin, kun hän jää luksuselämänsä rahoittamiseen kehitetyistä superhuijauksista kiinni rysän päältä.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: Intensiivisessä draamassa seurataan kahta high school -opiskelijaa, Hancockia ja Dannya, heidän valmistumisensa jälkeen. Hancock tyytyy cheerleader-tyttöystävänsä kanssa keskiluokkaiseen keskinkertaisuuteen ja etääntyy Dannysta ja tämän psykoottisesta vaimosta, Bevistä.

programme.title: To Rome With Love
programme.desc: To Rome With Love on yhteen maailman hurmaavimmista kaupungeista sijoittuva kaleidoskooppinen komedia, jota tähdittävät mm. Alec Baldwin ja Penélope Cruz sekä elokuvan ohjaaja Woody Allen. Tutustumme mm.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Perustuu tositarinaan neljästä ulkopuolisesta, jotka näkivät sen, minkä isot pankit, media ja valtionhallinto kielsivät: maailmantalouden romahtamisen. Rohkea sijoittaminen johtaa heidät pankkialan pimeälle puolelle, jossa kaikki on kyseenalaistettava.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Vietettyään kuusi vuotta sotavankeudessa sisällissodan aikana ystävällinen etelävaltiolaissotilas palaa tilalleen ja tapaa vaimonsa, joka on luullut hänen kuolleen. Pettynyt kosija paljastaa sotilaan huijariksi, ja että oikeaa Sommersbya syytetään murhasta.

programme.title: The Mothman Prophecies
programme.desc: Journalisti John Klein ja hänen vaimonsa Mary joutuvat kohtalokkaaseen onnettomuuteen. Vaimon kuoleman jälkeen Johnin pakkomielteeksi muodostuvat Maryn sairaalassa tekemät luonnokset, jotka kuvaavat tummaa, siivekästä hahmoa.

programme.title: The Dreamers
programme.desc: Kolme elokuvantuntijaa, amerikkalainen vaihto-opiskelija Matthew sekä kaksoset Théo ja Isabelle ovat tulleet läheisiksi yhteisen kiinnostuksen kohteensa vuoksi. Théon ja Isabellen epätavallinen intiimi yhteys kiehtoo Matthew’ta.

programme.title: Thanks for Sharing
programme.desc: Päällepäin ympäristökonsultti Adamilla, yksityisyrittäjä Mikellä ja ensiapulääkäri Neilillä ei ole mitään yhteistä, mutta he kaikki ovat mukana 12 askeleen ohjelmassa kohti vapautta riippuvuuksistaan.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris Wilton on nuori ja komea mutta rahaton tennisvalmentaja, joka sotkeutuu rikkaan perheen kuvioihin ryhdyttyään perheen tyttären valmentajaksi. Rakkaussuhteet kahden eri naisen kanssa pakottavat hänet julmaan rikokseen. Intohimoa, kiusauksia ja mielettömyyttä yläluokan Lontoossa.

programme.title: The Snow Queen, Part 2
programme.desc: The pursuit of the cocaine dealer continues and the plot thickens as Hunter and McCall's cases collide.

programme.title: The Beach Boy
programme.desc: The Beach Boy arrives in LA and begins to kill drug dealers. Hunter and McCall must figure out his next move.

programme.title: Guilty
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall pursue a convicted murderer who is free and has vowed to kill the jurors who convicted him.

programme.title: The Last Kill
programme.desc: A contract killer makes hits throughout the city in order to ingratiate himself with a criminal kingpin.

programme.title: Fire Man
programme.desc: Someone has been setting fires all over the city to empty warehouse, and Hunter and McCall are on the case.

programme.title: Sniper
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall go after a sniper who is killing blondes that remind him of his wife who jilted him.

programme.title: Case X
programme.desc: McCall goes undercover to help Hunter investigate the deaths of two models involved in pornographic films.

programme.title: Night Of The Dragons
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate a Chinese gang leader being pursued by a police officer with a personal interest

programme.title: The Biggest Man In Town
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall go undercover at an exclusive resort to find a blackmailer's killer.

programme.title: Rich Girl
programme.desc: A millionaire is nearly killed, his wife the prime suspect, until she's murdered.

programme.title: Killer In The Halloween Mask
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall witness a string of murders when they're assigned as technical advisers for a tv show.

programme.title: Rape And Revenge, Part 1
programme.desc: When McCall is raped by a South American diplomat immune from prosecution, Hunter follows him to his homeland.

programme.title: Rape And Revenge, Part 2
programme.desc: Against departmental orders, Hunter goes to South America to stalk a diplomat who raped McCall.

programme.title: Million Dollar Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall pursue a security guard turned thief as he searches for the money he stole and lost.

programme.title: The Big Fall
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall realize they're attracted to each other as they protect an endangered witness.

programme.title: Waiting For Mr. Wrong
programme.desc: Hunter becomes involved with a beautiful model he suspects of complicity in a jewelry robbery.

programme.title: Think Blue
programme.desc: Hunter helps a policeman who is framed for the murder of his wife.

programme.title: Blow-Up
programme.desc: Hunter pursues a package bomber whose ruthless methods are being used to kill the participants in his trial.

programme.title: War Zone
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall work to stop a brigade of suburban mercenaries plotting to break a drug dealer out of prison

programme.title: Burned
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall are given 72 hours to find an attorney who falsified his death.

programme.title: Scrap Metal
programme.desc: When a dying contract killer confesses he was paid to kill Hunter's father, Hunter pursues the true murderer.

programme.title: Fagin 1986
programme.desc: A teenager's death leads Hunter and McCall to a Fagin who commands a group of barrio boys to commit crimes.

programme.title: 62 Hrs. Of Terror
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate a student terror group in the car bombing of a Middle-Eastern consulate member.

programme.title: Death Machine
programme.desc: Hunter investigates a theft turned murder when a robbery victim hires a detective to retrieve stolen jewels.

programme.title: The Setup
programme.desc: Wrongly suspended from the force for beating a suspect, Hunter pursues the gangster who had him discredited.

programme.title: The Beautiful And The Dead, Part 1
programme.desc: When a dead girl disappears from Hunter's living room, he and McCall follow a trail of intrigue and murder.

programme.title: The Beautiful And The Dead, Part 2
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall's investigation into adultery and homicide pits them against a group of Russian spies.

programme.title: The Return Of Typhoon Thompson
programme.desc: Hunter and Dee get a murder case reopened in order to exonerate a paroled ex-boxer and find the real killer.

programme.title: Saturday Night Special
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate mysterious calls to a reporter about a series of murders.

programme.title: Overnight Sensation
programme.desc: Hunter attempts to apprehend a vicious robbery suspect while he clashes with a vindictive reporter.

programme.title: Change Partners And Dance
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall must work individually after they are separated as partners by their new precinct leader.

programme.title: Crime Of Passion
programme.desc: While investigating a homicide, McCall falls in love with the prime suspect - the victim's husband.

programme.title: The Castro Connection
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall attempt to break a cocaine syndicate apparently being run by one of Hunter's ex-partners.

programme.title: High Noon In L.A.
programme.desc: Hunter receives a death threat from a quick-tempered foreign official determined to avenge his brother's death

programme.title: From San Francisco With Love
programme.desc: A police detective aids in solving a series of murders connected to the estate of a deceased millionaire.

programme.title: True Confessions
programme.desc: The search for a vengeful woman suspected of murdering two men involved in her sister's cocaine-related death.

programme.title: Love, Hate And Sporty James
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall try to protect their informant, Sporty James, after he blackmails a ruthless cocaine dealer.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall's kidnapping-homicide investigation is thwarted by a rich industrialist.

programme.title: The Cradle Will Rock
programme.desc: McCall masquerades as a nightclub singer to investigate the disappearance of a rock music star.

programme.title: Bad Company
programme.desc: The malicious leader of paramilitary neo-Nazis take Hunter and McCall captive while planning their next attack

programme.title: Down And Under
programme.desc: Hunter goes to Australia to help solve a murder involving a former girlfriend who's been missing for 3 years.

programme.title: Straight To The Heart
programme.desc: Hunter falls in love with a beautiful professional killer who's connected to an arson case he's investigating.

programme.title: Requiem For Sergeant McCall
programme.desc: McCall is charged with murder when the prime suspect in her dead detective husband's case is found dead.

programme.title: Double Exposure
programme.desc: Sergeant McCall poses as a fashion model to expose a burglary ring preying on wealthy businessmen.

programme.title: The Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall pose as spouses to investigate the murder of a girl whose death exposes a Soviet plot.

programme.title: Any Second Now
programme.desc: A concert pianist is paralyzed by fear when a man jailed for her attempted murder is released from prison.

programme.title: A Child Is Born
programme.desc: A musician helps search for the assailant of a pregnant woman being kept alive until she can give birth.

programme.title: Crossfire
programme.desc: McCall fears that Hunter's temper will outweigh his judgement when his former girlfriend is murdered.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit, Part 1
programme.desc: McCall is shot and paralyzed after learning about a prostitution ring operating in a fleet of motor homes.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit, Part 2
programme.desc: As doctors prepare to operate on McCall, Hunter races to find whoever is killing potential witnesses.

programme.title: Shades
programme.desc: When Hunter disappears during an investigation, McCall and her new partner must find him before he's killed.

programme.title: Not Just Another John Doe
programme.desc: A murder, but the victim seemingly never existed, and the killing appears to be professionally done.

programme.title: Playing God
programme.desc: After the murder of a crime boss, Hunter and McCall face an ethical dilemma: arrest the killer or let him go.

programme.title: Madfin Shark Series S1 - Day One Pt. 2
programme.desc: Day one continues as the four teams search for huge hungry sharks in the beautiful waters of the coast of Key West, Florida.

programme.title: Loaded S1 - First Winter Storm
programme.desc: Ryan hauls ornery bison up icy hills while Joe transports nine million bees. Brenda takes on her first long haul with a tricky reefer unit.

programme.desc: Brenda braves Hurricane Sandy to deliver supplies. Joe battles desert heat with an oil drill, and Ryan faces a deadly ice storm.

programme.desc: The group of iconic anglers reunite for a week of fishing And camaraderie in Belize. Bill Klyn And Tom McGuane fish for snook, Lori-Ann Murphy And Zach Gilford go after bonefish And Michael Keaton And Tom Brokaw pursue permit And tarpon.

programme.title: Buccaneers and Bones S1 - Grey Ghosts
programme.desc: The team of anglers cast into the flats off the coast of Belize in pursuit of bonefish. Tom Brokaw And Bill Klyn casts from a boat, McGuane And Yvon Chouninard try their luck wading And Michael Keaton And Lori-Ann Murphy use both methods.

programme.desc: Host Ott DeFoe hunts down double-digit Largemouth Bass in a lake locked off in time in northern Florida.

programme.title: Gold Fever S1 - Blue Bucket the Oregon Trail
programme.desc: Travelling on the Oregon trail, Tom and his daughter Kia are hunting for the legendary Blue Bucket Mine.

programme.title: Backcountry Rescue S1 - Episode 1

programme.desc: The first priority of every mission is team safety, so when conditions on Pyramid Peak threaten Jake and Cody during a rescue, Tim demands they pump the breaks.

programme.desc: Nick and Laura create kick-ass tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears. They use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Then try to recreate a “miracle” arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

programme.desc: Empowered in Jozi the city of gold South Africa with the kids from Skateistan, leftfield artists and photographers, streetside Kotas, volcano sessions, Slappy screen printing, a backyard ramp and skating through an art gallery.

programme.title: Ainsley's Market Menu S1 - Willunga
programme.desc: In a South Australian town, Ainsley gathers rare pork loin for a spicy jerk dish, plus fresh berries and cream for a seasonal market dessert.

programme.title: Ainsley's Market Menu S1 - Warrnambool
programme.desc: At a coastal market in Victoria, Ainsley cooks up soy beef lollipops, a fresh fig and mozzarella plate, and jam-topped British drop scones.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - City Escape - Miami
programme.desc: To educate our children about the profound impact of travel we travel to Miami, Florida. We'll learn about the area's colorful history, taste test its cuisine, learn Latin dancing and experience an epic adventure through the everglades.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - Eco-Explore Your Backyard - California Coast to Santa Barbara
programme.desc: In this episode we remind viewers just how much you can find when exploring your own backyard by road tripping the California Coast to Santa Barbara! Swapping TV time to chats around the campfire and an exciting encounter with sea lions.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - Nywaigi Country
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong journeys to Australia’s tropical Far North Queensland to discover the culinary secrets of the Nywaigi people, the traditional owners of the land. In this episode he learns to cook Magpie Goose with Nywaigi Man Buddy Cassidy.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - Port Lincoln, SA
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong Journeys to the rugged coastal town of Port Lincoln, in South Australia to unlock the secrets of the local seafood. From locals, he learns how to trawl for wild prawns, harvest oysters and forages for unique coastal ingredients.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - Detroit
programme.desc: Punk rocker Jon-Mikal formed his band The Idiot Kids as a way to deal with his sexuality. After coming out to his family at 21, he uses writing and his stage performance as a form of therapy.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - The Journey Begins
programme.desc: Overcoming illness and the chaos of bustling Chennai city traffic, Jess rides with a diverse group through vibrant coastal towns, before venturing inland toward the mountains and the sacred town of Palani.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - A Rough Ride
programme.desc: Jess and her riders face challenges heading to Kodaikanal, forced to confront landslides, ride through rough terrain and make decisions on the fly. Crossing into Kerala and reaching the iconic tea fields, the gang is rewarded with an elephant sighting and a new addition to their ride crew in Munnar.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - New Crew
programme.desc: Jess sets off for Palakkad, exploring the region’s lush tea plantations and local tribal villages. As the crew heads into Karnataka, they visit a stunning waterfall and gain more riders along the way. As they continue toward Thirthahalli, Jess receives a phone call that could change everything for her and the group.

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - Beijing's Hutons
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture.

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province. They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why it's always attracting tourists.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - Jackfruit
programme.desc: In Bali's lush landscapes, Lauren explores the tropical origin of jackfruit, partnering with a Balinese chef to unveil age-old recipes and techniques, showcasing how this versatile fruit reigns supreme in traditional and modern dishes.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - Rice
programme.desc: Delve into the world of rice with Lauren as she explores different varieties, shares tricks, and puts her own twist on unique rice-based dishes, blending local and western recipes to create flavorful meals like Balinese Nasi Goreng and Risotto.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - Turmeric
programme.desc: Journey alongside Lauren as she delves into the vibrant world of turmeric. From infusing it into dishes like Urap Pakis to crafting a healthful elixir called Jamu, discover the captivating flavors against the breathtaking backdrop of Mount Agung.

programme.title: Streetfood Nomad: Kolkata S1 - A Twist on the Classic
programme.desc: In the northeast of India in the state of West Benghal, Kolkata lies on the banks of the Ganges River and is a melting pot of cultures and cuisines. Inspired by Kolkata's heritage, Will puts his own twist on classic Indian dishes, reinventing and infusing these recipes with unexpected flavours.

programme.title: Streetfood Nomad: Kolkata S1 - Eastern Port
programme.desc: The Eastern port Kolkata has been the centre for international merchants and migrants. The closest entry-point from China, in 1778 Kolkota became home to India’s only Chinese community. They have left an indelible mark on Kolkata’s architecture, culture and cuisine.

programme.title: Streetfood Nomad: Kolkata S1 - The Street Scene
programme.desc: Kolkata’s extraordinary street-food scene has been influenced by its various conquerors and rulers. The most profound influence has been from the fabulously rich and powerful Mughals. Will reimagines classic dishes while also incorporating the unique street food flavours he encounters.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - Frédéric Molina – Moulin de Léré
programme.desc: At the feet of the Jura mountains,”close to nature” chef Fredric Molina built up an ideal family restaurant and earned his first Michelin star. Let’s explore the secrets to his delicious food, his way of building a power team and how he finds harmony

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - René And Maxime Meilleur – La Bouitte
programme.desc: In this program we’ll get acquainted with the unique story of self-taught René and Maxime Meilleur, father and son running a three-star Michelin restaurant in Saint-Martin-de-Belleville in the Savoy region.

programme.title: Taste of France S1 - Alexandre Mazzia – AM
programme.desc: In this program we’ll meet two Michelin star chef, Alexandre Mazzia at his highly acclaimed restaurant in Marseilles. His daily challenge is not lack of inspiration, but to filter the massive influx of ideas that runs through his head.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - Philippines: Why is Filipino food unpopular?
programme.desc: Liesel embarks on a journey to the country of over 7000 islands, the Philippines. From the serene to the seedy, she combs through metro Manila discovering the food; this culinary spectrum includes bouncing around trying the popular fast food joints, meeting the local experts such as blogger Cheryl Tiu, a taste of history at the world's oldest Chinatown, an unexpected dancing session at the Spanish haunts of Manila, to rubbing shoulders with the elite Chefs of the city. All in a quest to answer just why Filipino cuisine is unheard of!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - Thailand: US Thai Food vs Authentic-Thai, which is the winner?
programme.desc: Liesel embarks on a journey to the country of over 7000 islands, the Philippines. From the serene to the seedy, she combs through metro Manila discovering the food; this culinary spectrum includes bouncing around trying the popular fast food joints, meeting the local experts such as blogger Cheryl Tiu, a taste of history at the world's oldest Chinatown, an unexpected dancing session at the Spanish haunts of Manila, to rubbing shoulders with the elite Chefs of the city. All in a quest to answer just why Filipino cuisine is unheard of!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - India: Can Kolkata be considered a foodie destination of India?
programme.desc: Liesel pinballs around a city known for its gastronomy, the forgotten hub of British East India trading company, Kolkata. From trying out what the bustling city’s vibrant street food scene has to offer, to the lesser known gems, including, venturing into India’s only Chinatown and sampling their delicacies. A tale of walking food tours, hole in the wall joints serving up North Eastern dumplings, messy fish markets, and of course, the pride of Bengal, the Hilsa fish. Is Kolkata up to par with the other major metropolitan cities of India? This episode finds out exactly that!

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - Sweetness in Nature
programme.desc: This episode demonstrates the diversity and complexity of sweetness and also shows us that nature itself is the greatest brewer, reminding us to return to nature and enjoy the pure sweetness in life.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - Sweetness in the Family
programme.desc: Cakes, maple syrup and taro puree tell a story of inheritance, memory and innovation in different parts of the world. They demonstrate how food can become a symbol of cultural identity and family heritage.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - Sweetness Migration
programme.desc: The program reveals the unique attraction of sweet food that allows it to transcend geographical boundaries to become a bond shared worldwide, a form of cultural expression, and a means of heritage prevention.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - Korea
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey land in Seoul to master Korean BBQ, study with a Kimchi Master, and cook Kiwi-Korean fusion for a panel of elite local foodies.

programme.title: Andy And Ben Eat the World S1 - Mexico City to Oaxaca
programme.desc: Andy and Ben land in Mexico, getting a local lunch, hitting street taco stalls, dining in traditional Puebla, and eating a kilo of meat each in Oaxaca

programme.title: Andy And Ben Eat the World S1 - Coast to Country
programme.desc: The boys land a massive sailfish in Puerto Escondido, learn to make blue corn tortillas in Chiapas, and cook a VIP meal for the Australian Ambassador.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - Jamaica
programme.desc: Gord Martin is in Jamaica to down a little food and raise a little hell. First he heads to Hellshire Bay, then on to the Blue Mountains to learn authentic lip smackin' Jamaican cuisine from a renowned local chef... But mastering those dumplings is harder than it looks!

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - Mexico
programme.desc: Gord Martin is in Mexico where he dives off the tourist map to reveal the authentic cuisine of the Mayan Riviera. After stopping in at a well-stocked tequileria for an extensive tasting session, he samples a street vendor's colourful taco varieties, and visits a supermarket with a vast array of local and exotic produce.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - Belize
programme.desc: Gord is in Dangriga, Belize to explore the country's unique melting pot of African, Spanish and Caribbean cuisines. Taking to the streets, he tastes the wares of vendor after vendor - Johnnycakes, tamales, garnaches - Belize's heavenly taco. And then at the Dangriga market, our Delinquent Gourmet discovers varieties of fish he's never even heard of!

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and special guests.

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature.

programme.title: Foodwise S1 - Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - Nevada: What else is there in Nevada for foodies besides Vegas?
programme.desc: This investigative mission starts off in the sin city atmosphere of the Vegas strip. After a gluttonous stint at a generic buffet, Liesel is inspired to do a road trip to find iconic gems in the state of Nevada. From ghost towns, to monstrous foodie challenges, to hole in the wall dive bars in the middle of nowhere, this trip has it all. Liesel finds the resurgence of Basque cuisine in Northern Nevada, and learns that Reno can do fine dining as well! A trip to Virginia city also reveals that the Silver State has some haunted bars where patrons from the 1800s are rumored to be still imbibing and spooking locals! It’s a road trip in every sense of the word!

programme.title: The Streets S1 - Houston
programme.desc: Jamie Hancock was raised in Houston’s South Park area, a place notorious for gang violence, but also where hip hop artists created a new sound. Today, a new positive message is being created by people like Jamie through music.

programme.title: Andy And Ben Eat the World S1 - Mexico City to Oaxaca
programme.desc: Andy and Ben land in Mexico, getting a local lunch, hitting street taco stalls, dining in traditional Puebla, and eating a kilo of meat each in Oaxaca

programme.title: Andy And Ben Eat the World S1 - Coast to Country
programme.desc: The boys land a massive sailfish in Puerto Escondido, learn to make blue corn tortillas in Chiapas, and cook a VIP meal for the Australian Ambassador.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - Bangkok
programme.desc: Jack dives into the chaotic, aromatic world of Thailand's street food capital to see who can balance the ultimate sweet and sour flavors.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - Mildura, Vienna, Hahndorf
programme.desc: Join Alana as she visits her home town of Mildura and then onto the beautiful Austrian capital Vienna. Scotty heads up north to the Western Australian pearl town of Broome and Skye explores the delicacies of Hahndorf, South Australia.

programme.title: Hamekyttä - Pojasta Polvi Paranee

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Newyorkilainen työhullu kustannustoimittaja Jackie seuraa poikaansa Los Angelesiin. Poika haluaa jättää opiskelut sikseen ja elää unelmaansa Kaliforniassa, missä myös äidillä on pian edessään tyrskyjä ja kuohuja.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Tervetuloa Westburgin lukioon jossa halitsee kolme kauneuskuningatarta, Heather C, Heather M ja Heather D. Heillä on valta, ulkonäkö ja rahat tehdäkseen mitä he haluavat.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä

Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Vuosi on 1985. Pastellivärien, puutelihiusten ja otsanauhojen aikakautena nuori Janey uneksii tanssijan urasta. Koulua hän on ehtinyt vaihtaa jo 11 kertaa, ja hän tietää että ne eivät muutu miksikään.

programme.title: Peace, Love And Misunderstanding

programme.title: Middle School: The Worst Years Of My Life

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone on Long Islandin paras lennonjohtaja, kunnes hiljainen muukalainen, Russell Bell, siirretään hänen osastolleen. Näiden New York TRACONin kahden huippulennonjohtajan välinen kilvoittelu eskaloituu mahdollisesti vaaralliselle tasolle.

programme.title: Vampyyrien Imussa
programme.desc: Becca, angstinen teini uudessa koulussa, päätyykeskelle kahden yliluonnollisen kosijan soidintanssia– toinen heistä oikukas vampyyri ja toinenkäsittämättömän karvainen ihmissusi. ScaryMovien tekijätiimin hervoton revittely!

programme.title: The Funeral Party
programme.desc: Felix Bush haluaa suunnitella omat hautajaisensa ja pyytää apuja järjestelyihin paikalliselta hautausurakoitsijalta Frank Quinnilta. Paikalla tulee olla jokaisen, jolla on kerrottavanaan tarina hänestä. Tärkeintä on, että riennoissa on mukana myös päivänsankari itse – elävänä.

programme.title: What Just Happened?
programme.desc: Viikko Hollywood-tuottajan Benin elämässä. Ben neuvottelee studiojohtajan kanssa, jotta hänen uusin elokuvansa saisi ensi-iltansa Cannesissa kahden viikon kuluttua. Hän on hermostunut ohjaaja, jonka on tehtävä editointi elokuvaan.

programme.title: Growing Up and Other Lies
programme.desc: Vuosia taiteilijana New Yorkissa riutunut Jake aikoo palata kotiin Ohioon. Viimeisenä päivänään kaupungissa hän kutsuu kolme vanhinta ystäväänsä mukaan nostalgiselle kävelyretkelle Manhattanin päästä päähän. Yritys palata huolettomaan nuoruuteen ei suju ihan toiveiden mukaisesti.

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes' epic 1943 western, but the character you'll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes' nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes' infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: Oscar winner Michael Curtiz (Casablanca, Mildred Pierce) directed this exciting drama about Army officer Jeb Stuart and the days leading up to the Civil War. Errol Flynn (The Adventures of Robin Hood) stars as Stuart, with Olivia de Havilland as his romantic interest (the seventh of nine times they were paired together by Warner Bros.) The cast includes Ronald Reagan as General George Custer, and Raymond Massey as John Brown, with such familiar faces as Alan Hale and Van Hefflin in supporting roles. Filmed partly in Santa Fe!

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho protect a man being chased by outlaws who believe he is responsible for a gold robbery. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho break a woman out of prison before she is hanged for murder.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog.. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode aired in 1950.

programme.desc: A town blames the son-in-law of a the bank president for his murder. Cisco and Pancho work to uncover the truth before the townspeople hang the man. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. This episode aired in 1950. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: After arriving in the town of Sundance, Cisco witnesses the destruction of a newspaper office. Upon seeing this, Cisco contends with the man trying to take over the town. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. This episode aired in 1950. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Matt Clark goes undercover working at a gambling den. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Directed by William Witney. Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Episode first aired in 1954.Series won an Emmy in 1955. Also starring Dick SImmons, Claire Carleton, Mauritz Hugo, Howard Wright, and Douglas Evans.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Frankie is shot during a robbery. Her life becomes in danger when her doctor is kidnapped by the murderous outlaw Clay Allison.Starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, Jack Kelly, Paul Farber, Frank Fenton, and Fred Sherman.Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954. Produced by B movie veteran Edward White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: A railroad detective pursues the infamous female outlaw, Belle Starr, after a herd of horses are stolen from the U.S. Calvalry. This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Belle Starr is played by Mary Windsor. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Jim Davis stars as railroad detective Matt Clark who needs to track down a group of cattle rustlers along with their notorious leader Billy the Kid (played by Richard Jaeckel).This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook come across a girl in the woods who is running away from a man named Stark. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook help an old woman find her son who has been missing for 18 years.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook help the long-lost son of a Cree tribal chief.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingacchook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook go undercover as managers of a trading post. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: A trader ignites a war between the Hurons and the settlers. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: After a long winter, the Tuscarora tribe struggles for survival. Hawkeye and Chingachcook set out to help.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingacchook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Tribesmen war over the daughter of a Mingo Chief. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Winter essentials are stolen on their way to a village. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Northwest Trail
programme.desc: Mountie Matt OBrien assignment is simple: He is to escort the rather grouchy, and slightly annoying, Miss Katherine Owens to a remote outpost. Things complicate however when they arrive at the outpost and he stumbles upon an illegal mining operation. Stars include Bob Steele, Joan Woodbury, and Poodles Hanneford.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. This time Hopalong goes undercover to expose a group of ranchers who are interfering with the building of a new railroad. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and captures Clay Hartley Jr. The latter is quickly tried and convicted of the killing of the deputy, and sentenced to be hung. Sheriff Hartley has only a few hours to prove his son was not the killer. He enlists the aid of Collins' step-daughter, Joan, who is in love with Hartley's son.

programme.title: The Range Busters
programme.desc: In the first of the Range Buster series, a mysterious figure is killing the help at the Circle T Ranch. The Range Busters are called in to help, but cant figure out the murderers identity. Is it Torrence, a longtime rival of the Circle T, or is it blind uncle Rolph? Ray Crash Corrigan, John Dusty King, and Alibi Max Terhune head the cast. Director S. Roy Luby (Border Phantom, Black Market Rustlers), also has a fine list of supporting players, including Luana Walters, Leroy Mason, and Kermit Maynard.

programme.title: Fast Bullets
programme.desc: Tom Tyler stars in this vintage western from the short-lived Reliable Pictures Company, a group known for low budgets and lots of action. In this feature, Tom reforms a gang member in order to infiltrate a ring of thieves. Rex Lease, Margaret Nearing, and Al Bridge also star.

programme.title: Call of the Forest
programme.desc: There's plenty of drama in this tale of lost gold mines, gallant stallions, and fuzzy bears. Starring Ken Curtis, Robert Lowery, and Chief Thundercloud, this charming little film is highlighted by Karl Struss' stunning photography

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: Flagg is relocating flood victims to Gunsmoke Ranch. The Three Mesquiteers know Flagg to be a crook and try to warn them. They ignore the warning and improve the land only to find that it has been condemned for a new dam.

programme.title: Stagecoach to Denver
programme.desc: Ride the outlaws' highway! Allan Rocky Lane stars as Red Ryder, shootin' and fightin' his way to justice in this old slugfest from Republic Pictures. This time he's a stagecoach driver battling a crooked land commissioner and his cohorts, including a sheriff on the take. Robert Blake costars as Little Beaver!

programme.title: Young Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars in this highly fictionalized account of Bill Cody's life from director Joseph Kane (Dakota, Flame of Barbary Coast). What it lacks in accuracy is made up for with adventure, as well as and some of Roy's great cowboy songs, including 'Blow Breeze Blow', and 'Rollin' Down to Santa Fe'. Other stars include George 'Gabby' Hayes, Chief Thundercloud, and the lovely Pauline Moore (Young Mr. Lincoln, Charlie Chan at Treasure Island)

programme.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time theyre trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who dont like competition. Sally Payne is on-hand as a member of the troop where Roy and Gabby work as entertainers, while Carol Adams plays a reporter who may have a romantic interest in Roy. Songs include Song of the Dusty Trail, and Home on the Rangeland.

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: Baseball superstar Gehrig is one of several ranchers being coerced by a bunch of bandits. His sister and her lawyer/lover organize the ranchers. Directed by Ray Taylor; starring Smith Ballew, Gehrig, Evelyn Knapp. Talk about stunt casting! Gehrig was a New York Yankees star who was nearing the end of his career, but one of the biggest sports stars in the country. In the movie he plays a variation of himself, as Lou Gehrig, a retired baseball player who takes up ranching. Lou expects to relax on his ranch but quickly joins other ranchers in a fight to protect their properties.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's legendary career.

programme.title: Winds of the Wasteland
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this Republic Pictures western about the final days of the Pony Express. Former rider John Blair (Wayne) enters a coach race to win a $25,000 government mail contract, but there are dozens of obstacles in his path. The rest of the cast includes Lane Chandler and Phyllis Fraser, plus Lew Kelly (Lady of Burlesque) doing a great comic turn as Rocky OBrien, the eccentric, self-proclaimed mayor of a deserted mining town.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Doomed Caravan
programme.desc: Hoppy is enlisted to help protect Jane Travers' next caravan against robbers who have been terrorizing travelers. He comes across a wily pair of thieves who hve their men disguised as soldiers to escort the caravan. Hoppy isn't fooled for a second and busts up their plan with help from the Bar 20 boys. Not to be outdone, the thieves then capture everyone but Hoppy and puts them before a firing squad. Not it's up to Hoppy to rescue his friends singlehandedly. The cast includes William Boyd as Hopalong Cassidy, with Russell Hayden and Andy Clyde as Luky Jenkins and California Jack. For those counting, this was the 32nd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. They would be edited for syndication on television, bringing Hoppy and his friends to a whole new generation of fans.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair...

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his crew get involved in a war over water rights in this feature from Harry Sherman Productions and Paramount Pictures. The intrigue starts when crafty Joe Weller (Morris Ankrum) turns two ranchers against each other, which leads to dire results. This is the 33rd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy movies, with WIlliam Boyd in the role he made famous. Also, look for regular Hoppy co-stars Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Andy Clyde as California Carson.

programme.title: Pick a Puppy
programme.desc: Get cozy with tiny greyhounds, pulis, and terriers, who impress a lively family.

programme.title: Unstable
programme.desc: Learn why living the dream of owning a barn can sometimes feel like a nightmare.

programme.title: Pick a Puppy
programme.desc: Investigate malamutes, Leonbergers, and other giant, gentle family playmates.

programme.title: Pick a Puppy
programme.desc: Look for a pup who can do double duty as a pet and helper for a boy with autism.

programme.title: Hope For Wildlife
programme.desc: A most unusual fawn arrives on Hope’s doorstep. A graveyard is the spooky setting for an unlikely reunion.

programme.title: ER Vets
programme.desc: Tend to a chihuahua’s busted leg, a stressed-out cat, and extensive extractions.

programme.title: ER Vets
programme.desc: Find a solution for a dog’s chronic tail injuries and aid a flu-stricken ferret.

programme.title: ER Vets
programme.desc: Tackle kitty paralysis, dog heart issues, and a pup’s chronic knee problem.

programme.title: ER Vets
programme.desc: Probe a dog’s scary seizures, watch dragon surgery, and test a kitty for cancer.

programme.title: The Bizarre Pet Vets

programme.title: Concerto – OSN Gatti Bruckner Wagner Torino
programme.desc: In January 2022, Daniele Gatti conducted the Orchestra Sinfonica Nazionale della Rai at the Turin Auditorium, performing Wagner’s Parsifal excerpts and Bruckner’s Symphony No. 9. The programme highlighted Wagner's meditative Prelude to Act III and Good Friday Spell, followed by Bruckner’s profound Ninth Symphony, marked by its emotional depth and unfinished final movement.

programme.title: Whats On Special and Unique Festivals
programme.desc: From Malta to Morocco, unique festivals capture Mediterranean creativity. Malta hosts the Valletta Green Festival, Notte Bianca, Malta Air Show, and Gharb International Kite and Wind Festival. Portugal celebrates with Festa das Cruzes, Morocco Dream City Festival dazzles with arts and music, Croatia brings the avant garde MoDem Festival, and Italy hosts the historic Venice Debutante Grand Ball. These festivals showcase the extraordinary, the festive, and the unforgettable.

programme.title: MED Destination ANTIPAROS
programme.desc: WITH VO

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: Discover the wonders of southern France as we savor Roman ruins in Nîmes, a papal palace in Avignon, Van Gogh's vivid views in Arles, and the vineyards of the Côtes du Rhône.

programme.title: Outdoor and Nature
programme.desc: OUTDOOR And Nature, a weekly program that highlights sports, outdoor activities, and the breathtaking scenery of Cyprus, will introduce you to the great outdoors. Each episode highlights government initiatives, community organisations, and volunteer efforts to preserve Cyprus's natural heritage while examining nature, wildlife, and conservation. Take a trip of inspiration, exploration, and adventure with hosts Panicos Pilalis and Aristo Aristeidou. Listen and get motivated to go on your own outdoor adventure in Cyprus!

programme.title: Sinj
programme.desc: Sinj blends courage, tradition, and warm hospitality—reflected even in its food. Edo Crljen welcomed us with a bold serving of tripes, while Ankica Vlastelica prepared the town’s pride: arambaši, Sinj’s iconic stuffed cabbage rolls you simply can’t leave without tasting.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Amalfi
programme.desc: Malini Angelica travels to Italy’s stunning Amalfi Coast, exploring its dramatic cliffs, colorful seaside towns, and crystal-clear waters. From the charm of Positano and Amalfi to the tranquility of Ravello, she experiences the region’s beauty, cuisine, and coastal lifestyle. Malini captures the magic that makes the Amalfi Coast one of Italy’s most breathtaking destinations.

programme.title: Concerto – OSN Gatti Bruckner Wagner Torino

The programme highlighted Wagner's meditative Prelude to Act III and Good Friday Spell, followed by Bruckner’s profound Ninth Symphony, marked by its emotional depth and unfinished final movement.

programme.title: Colours of Mediterranean Culture
programme.desc: From Malta to Greece, Mediterranean arts flourish. Valletta Baroque Festival, Malta International Arts Festival, and Birgu by Candlelight light up the island with music and heritage. Italy’s Cortona on the Move, La Fenice in Piazza San Marco, and Mercantia Festival showcase photography, opera, and street performance. France’s Art Paris and International Garden Festival, Spain’s Revela’t Festival and La Leyenda de Tartessos, Portugal’s Umbrella Sky Project and Walk And Talk Biennale, Turkey’s Istanbul Theatre Festival and Biennial, and Greece’s Athens And Epidaurus Festival highlight the Med’s rich artistic tapestry.

programme.desc: WITH VO

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Ease Anxiety with Movement
programme.desc: Mediterranean Yoga is a series that blends Embodiment Yoga with the peaceful beauty of the Mediterranean. Set in stunning coastal and natural locations, each episode encourages viewers to reconnect mind and body through gentle movement, breathwork, and mindfulness in a safe and calming space.

programme.title: Memoirs Sept 03
programme.desc: Memoirs Sept 03

programme.title: Med Whats On Extraordinary Events
programme.desc: Spring is transforming the Mediterranean into a massive stage for high-tech art and spectacular outdoor events. We begin at the Ta Qali National Park for the Bloom Festival, where wellness and music create a vibrant sanctuary in the heart of Malta. From there, we head into the tunnels and forts of Valletta and Birgu for the Malta Biennale 2026 to discover contemporary installations hidden inside historic sites rarely seen by the public. Our journey takes us to the cliffs of Gozo as giant creative designs fill the sky for the International Kite and Wind Festival before we land in Venice to witness the world class creativity of the 61st International Art Exhibition. This is a look at a region in the middle of a stunning cultural rebirth.

programme.title: Med Minds 01 Caravaggio

programme.title: Med Nations 07 Croatia

programme.title: Med Whats On Extraordinary Events
programme.desc: Spring is transforming the Mediterranean into a massive stage for high-tech art and spectacular outdoor events. We begin at the Ta Qali National Park for the Bloom Festival, where wellness and music create a vibrant sanctuary in the heart of Malta. From there, we head into the tunnels and forts of Valletta and Birgu for the Malta Biennale 2026 to discover contemporary installations hidden inside historic sites rarely seen by the public. Our journey takes us to the cliffs of Gozo as giant creative designs fill the sky for the International Kite and Wind Festival before we land in Venice to witness the world class creativity of the 61st International Art Exhibition. This is a look at a region in the middle of a stunning cultural rebirth.

programme.desc: Valentina Caruso and Francesco Gasparri explore the Strait of Messina, where unique underwater currents create an oceanic ecosystem within the Mediterranean. Diver Domenico Majolino and marine biologist Simona Ratti explain its natural wonders, while Vincenzo Annuario tells the story of the Cariddi ferry, reborn after serving in the navy. programme.title: Killing Daisy
programme.desc: Gerald wakes up every morning with a note to 'Kill Daisy' but with no previous memories of his life, he is unsure of what it all means.

programme.title: Searching For Clues
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Chief Abe’s children, Frank and Sandra, return home upon hearing that their father is suffering from an incurable disease and his days are numbered, but when Chief Abe is murdered, they become prime suspect in the police investigation. Are they the most likely culprits to this crime?

programme.title: Perfect Crime
programme.desc: To the outside world, Brenda and Toby seem like a loving couple until little secrets she is keeping from her family start to unravel, leading to fatal consequences.

programme.title: Bitter Love
programme.desc: Jordan, a notorious playboy is faced with an unexpected ultimatum. To claim his inheritance, he must do the one thing he swore he’d never do, get married. Forced to trade his bachelor antics for a life of commitment, Jordan scrambles to find the perfect partner but soon realises that love, and marriage, isn’t as simple as sealing a deal.

programme.title: Whispered Heart
programme.desc: Whispered Heart follows a group of high-school students navigating health, emotions, friendships and all the in-between.

programme.title: Sincerity
programme.desc: Successful model, Britney, hires Adora as her personal stylist, but their professional relationship soon deepens into a genuine friendship. As trust builds, Britney entrusts Adora with a long-held, shameful secret. Meanwhile, Adora finds herself entangled in a complicated love triangle but when she confides in the wrong person, betrayal sends their worlds spiraling, threatening their bond and exposing the secrets they fought to protect.

programme.title: Two Weeks Later
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Plagued with loving and hating her boss, Rachel resigns from work to start a life but two weeks later, everything changes as her boss comes calling with an offer she has only imagined in her dreams.

programme.title: Grip
programme.desc: A wealthy man, who has vowed to never fall in love, meets a woman that refuses to fall for his charms, forcing him to re-evaluate his stance on relationships.

programme.title: Burning Pain
programme.desc: After his wife becomes sick and unable to move properly, Michael takes on the extra responsibility of caring for her. Is he doing this out of the goodness of his heart or is there something nefarious going on behind close doors?

programme.title: Today Is Gone
programme.desc: A sweet relationship turns out to be not so sweet as time goes on and platonic relationships between friends turn into something more, causing all kinds of complications.

programme.title: Wrongfully Hers
programme.desc: Hijinks follows after Perpetual, pretending to be a sophisticated socialite, befriends Gina who has fallen in love with Esa, not realising he is Perpetual's unappreciated boyfriend.

programme.title: Samantha
programme.desc: An estranged couple decide to get together, along with their new partners, to discuss the custody and well-being of the estranged couple's daughter, Samantha. Things start to go awry as old wounds are reopened and old feelings, good and bad start to resurface.

programme.title: Turbulance
programme.desc: Two friends, facing different struggles, lean on each other for support as their lives begin to unravel.

programme.title: A Mother's Heart
programme.desc: A man's love for his daughter is tested as another woman in his life comes in contest to that love.

programme.title: Ex-Wife
programme.desc: Dozie's daughters think he needs a girlfriend so he can stop being over-protective, so they try to set him up with a woman they like. When he finally meets someone he wants to have a relationship with, complications show up in the form of his ex-wife.

programme.title: Falling For You
programme.desc: After causing her to lose her job by wrongly accusing her of theft, Lothana tries to do everything in his power to get back in Uzoma's good graces.

programme.title: Sister Act
programme.desc: The beautiful bond between three sisters crumbles as their desires become too selfish, putting each other in danger.

programme.title: Guy Man and London Babe
programme.desc: When a man meets his dream 'London babe', he’ll do anything to be with her, even falsely accusing his fiancée of cheating, just to end the relationship. But his plan backfires in the most unexpected and hilarious ways.

programme.title: Rekindle
programme.desc: Kofi meets Iris, a beautiful woman during her vacation to Ghana and becomes infatuated with her, but she leaves him without leaving any information as to where she can be reached. When he goes to Nigeria to visit, he is surprised to be greeted by a familiar face claiming to be his cousin, Frank’s fiancé.

programme.title: Before I Go
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Sam and Grace’s lives are changed forever after an accident renders Sam unable to move and confined to a wheelchair for life. As Sam contemplates taking his own life, a chance meeting with a stranger changes everything.

programme.title: One Day One Trouble
programme.desc: All hell breaks loose when Ego, a troublemaker, visits her brother's house and causes problems in his relationship.

programme.title: Tainted
programme.desc: Somto's excitement of introdcuing his girlfriend, Mara, to his family turns into anger and frustration when they vehemently refuse to accept their relationship because of where she is from.

programme.title: Still The One
programme.desc: Janet becomes jealous of her younger sister, Natasha, when Natasha gets engaged to Desmond, a man Janet is in love with. Things become toxic when Janet interferes with Natasha's career in hopes to get her out of the way.

programme.title: Heart Of Women
programme.desc: A wicked woman learns her lesson after she has to ask her maid, who she has been cruel to, for a life-changing favour.

programme.title: In-Between
programme.desc: Asia's paranoia always gets the best of her in all her relationships, leaving her constantly searching for the perfect man. She finally believes she has found him in Bill, but her perfect man may have some imperfections of his own.

programme.title: Business Men
programme.desc: In a bid to make some extra cash and impress the family of his beloved, David unknowingly gets involved with some nefarious characters leading up to a major police investigation.

programme.title: Jimmy Jones
